title: Final IRRBB regulations: Their implications and challenges
summary: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) recently published final interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB) regulations. As defined by the BCBS, “IRRBB refers to the current or prospective risk to the bank’s capital and earnings arising from adverse movements in interest rates.” To reduce excessive interest rate risk, banks will need to ensure that the right processes for identifying, measuring, monitoring and controlling IRRBB are in place. IT infrastructure alignment, in particular, is crucial to successful compliance with the new requirements.
